data.name: Battle Spirit
data.description: A shaman surrounds herself with the spirit of battle. Allies within 30 feet of the shaman (including the shaman) receive a +%1 morale bonus on attack rolls and weapon damage rolls. The shaman can use this ability %2 rounds/day. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.|ShamanBattleSpiritBonus|ShamanBattleSpiritRounds
